headline: As of 2026-10-21: 14,113,090 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 42 of 50 states, D+16.4 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 14,113,090 early/mail ballots cast so far across 42 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+16.4 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (1,716,890), Florida (1,394,608), Georgia (1,186,854).
